_comment: Run state for the SEO/AEO routine. Updated each run. Baselines are a cache; the authoritative time series is the committed seo/data/gsc/ files.
_serp_rotation_note: Index selects clusters (excluding aeo-sentinels) in portfolio order: for k in 0..2, cluster[(index+k) % 9], query[floor(index/9) % len]. Index 0 covered used-car-to-ebike / new-to-boston / family-logistics. Index 3 covered year-round-weather / town-commuters / ebike-curious. Index 6 covers employers-rto / schools-wellness / local-business-partners.

baselines._basis: EXACT. Recomputed 2026-08-31 from the sixteen weekly files containing site_totals (2026-05-09 -> 2026-08-28), verified contiguous with no overlapping ranges. Files WITHOUT site_totals are the superseded 2026-08-20 backfill and must be excluded — mixing the series double-counts.
baselines._nonbrand_note: Bucketed non-brand query-dimension impressions, replaying the item-2 branch patterns. 48 on 2026-08-24, 49 on 2026-08-31. This is the number the strategy is actually accountable for; the headline total is carried by brand.
baselines._posthog_note: Excludes mail-security link-scanner sessions (paths matching '%/1/0100%' or '/preferences/%'), which added 9 phantom 'bing.com' sessions in the week of 2026-08-24. Always apply that filter; see seo/reports/2026-08-31.md finding 4.

health._llms_note: /llms.txt is generated per request from approved guides + qualifying towns (src/app/llms.txt/route.ts), so its hash changes whenever content is published. Treat hash drift as expected; the link and section counts are the meaningful drift signals.

carryover_serp_checks.why: WebSearch returned 'unavailable' on two attempts during the 2026-08-31 run; not checked, not an absence.

watch_list.what: Used cargo e-bike price demand: two variants of '"tern gsd" used "$3000"' took 10 impressions at position 10, and /guides/what-you-can-do-with-an-e-cargo-bike went 10 -> 38 impressions. First organic sign of the used-car-to-ebike wedge. Feed into the September deep-dive's portfolio re-evaluation.
watch_list.action: Watch for recurrence; do not act on one week.

watch_list.what: /commute-advisor carries only Organization + AdministrativeArea JSON-LD — no FAQPage, HowTo or WebApplication — despite being the highest-impression page on the site and ranking on question-shaped queries.
watch_list.action: Cover in the September deep-dive AEO health pass.

watch_list.what: The stagnation trigger reads total organic clicks, which brand searches dominate. Non-brand discovery impressions were flat (48 -> 49) while the headline rose 51% over four weeks. The trigger would not fire on a flat discovery trend.
watch_list.action: Reconsider the trigger's basis at the September deep-dive.

watch_list.what: Drive-time guide shipped. Its two sibling pages (/commute-advisor, /guides/when-walking-is-faster) took 472 impressions and 0 clicks in the week of 2026-08-22. Also watch for cannibalisation between the new guide and when-walking-is-faster.
watch_list.action: Report the three pages together in the ledger each week until ~2026-10-12, then call it.

resolved_notes.what: Email 401 on the first attempts. Two different secrets share the name CRON_SECRET: gsi-website/.env.local holds the Vercel cron secret guarding this repo's /api/cron/* routes, while the Supabase edge functions use a separate deployed CRON_SECRET. The Shift project injects the Supabase-side value via an env block in its .claude/settings.local.json, which is why sentry-triage and plg-review (both run from the Shift directory) always worked. gsi-website had no env block, so $CRON_SECRET was empty here.
resolved_notes.fix: Added a matching env block to gsi-website/.claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Verified: HTTP 200, sent to keith@gogreenstreets.org.
resolved_notes.do_not: Do not overwrite CRON_SECRET in .env.local to 'fix' this — that value is correct and in use by six Vercel cron routes.

resolved_notes.what: Branches seo/2026-08-gsc-true-totals and seo/2026-08-portfolio-patterns were cut before a week of unrelated work landed on main, so their diffs against main showed ~125 files and would have reverted the walk-audit and events-calendar commits if merged.
resolved_notes.fix: Rebased both onto main and force-pushed with --force-with-lease. Each is now a clean single-file diff.
resolved_notes.do_not: Do not let a proposed branch sit unrebased across a week of main activity — rebase pending seo/ branches at the start of each run before quoting their diffs.

resolved_notes.what: Shipping item 1 re-backfilled 16 weekly files on Saturday-to-Friday windows, but the 16 original Monday-ending files from the 2026-08-20 backfill stayed on disk. The two series overlap, so a naive glob over weekly-*.json would double-count.
resolved_notes.fix: Deleting the superseded files was blocked by the auto-mode permission classifier, so the fix is a selection rule instead: the current series is defined as files containing site_totals, written into seo/methodology.md under the accountability ledger. Verified that selection is contiguous and reproduces the 2026-08-31 baselines exactly.
resolved_notes.do_not: Do not glob seo/data/gsc/weekly-*.json without filtering on site_totals. Do not read the level from `totals` — that field is query-dimension and runs ~4x under.

resolved_notes.what: After the migration published the guide, /guides did not list it and llms.txt/sitemap did not include it. sitemap.ts and llms.txt/route.ts both set revalidate = 3600 and self-heal within the hour, but src/app/guides/page.tsx had no revalidate, so the library index was statically baked at build time and would only update on the next deploy.
resolved_notes.fix: Added `export const revalidate = 3600` to src/app/guides/page.tsx to match the sibling files.
resolved_notes.do_not: Do not assume a guide is discoverable just because its own /guides/<slug> URL returns 200. After shipping a guide, check the /guides index, sitemap.xml and llms.txt too — the slug route is dynamic and will 200 well before the index catches up.
